test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct indirect narration of the given sentence.**

Mother said to Ravi, “Wash your hands before eating.”

options.text: Mother said to Ravi to wash your hands before eating.
Mother said Ravi must wash his hands before he was eating.
Mother told Ravi to wash his hands before eating.
Mother told to Ravi you have to wash your hands before eating.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Mother told Ravi to wash his hands before eating.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is a direct speech and we need to convert it into an indirect speech.
 
• We follow these rules in Direct-Indirect speech:
 
 
• The reporting verb 'said to' changes to 'told' in the indirect speech.
 
• The pronoun 'your' changes to 'his' in the indirect speech.
 
• The inverted commas ("...") are replaced with the preposition 'to' to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The comma (,) is omitted to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The first word of the indirect speech is in capital letters.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

The indirect sentence is: *Mother told Ravi to wash his hands before eating.*
